title: Absolutely not useful for hand or glass drying. Survives the laundry - no shrinking or color bleeding
text: Absolutely not useful for hand or glass drying. Survives the laundry - no shrinking or color bleeding. Grrr. Yet another dish towel that does not actually dry my hands after I wash them. This drives me crazy. I just want to wash my hands and dry them without my skin being damp afterwards. This a pretty towel and the blue stripes don't bleed in the wash, nor does it shrink. The edges are fully hemmed and it feels well made so one assumes that it should last for years. I guess it will in my house, because it's best suited as decoration or perhaps a bread basket liner rather than an actual useful daily kitchen towel.
